title: Swashbuckle.AspNetCore
description: Add Swagger UI and OpenAPI documentation to ASP.NET Core APIs with Swashbuckle.

data.text: `Swashbuckle.AspNetCore` is the most popular package for adding Swagger UI and OpenAPI specifications to ASP.NET Core APIs. It auto-generates documentation from your controllers, models, and XML comments.
Register Swagger in `Program.cs` and optionally enable XML comments for richer descriptions.

data.title: Enable Swagger in Program.cs

data.text: Enable XML documentation in the project file and pass the path to `SwaggerGen` to include summary and remarks in the OpenAPI document.

data.title: Load XML Comments in Program.cs

terms.definition: An interactive web page that lets you explore and test API endpoints.
A specification for describing REST APIs, formerly known as Swagger.
A service that discovers API endpoints and their metadata.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use `RoutePrefix = string.Empty` to serve Swagger UI at `/` in development.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Swashbuckle auto-generates OpenAPI docs from your API.
Enable XML comments for better descriptions.
Swagger UI gives you a built-in testing dashboard.
data.takeaway: Swashbuckle.AspNetCore is the standard way to document and explore .NET APIs.

data.title: Exercise: Add Swagger to an API
data.description: Add Swashbuckle to an existing ASP.NET Core Web API and verify Swagger UI loads.
steps: Add AddEndpointsApiExplorer and AddSwaggerGen in Program.cs.
Run the app and navigate to `/swagger`.
data.expectedOutcome: Your API is documented and explorable via Swagger UI.
